game.title: Baibalaa
game.description: A rugged physical sport similar to kabaddi but played in a circular ring on soft sand. Combines elements of tag and wrestling as players attempt to tag opponents and escape.
game.occasion: Eid al-Adha, national tournaments, beach gatherings
howToPlay: Step 1: A circular ring is marked on soft beach sand.
Step 2: One team stands inside the ring, the other outside.
Step 3: A player from outside enters the ring to tag opponents.
Step 4: The entering player must physically touch an opponent.
Step 5: Inside team tries to capture and hold the attacker.
Step 6: Captured players signal surrender and are out for the round.
Step 7: Attackers earn points for successful tags and escapes.
Step 8: Teams alternate roles each round.
Step 9: Soft sand minimizes injury from falls.
Step 10: Annual national tournaments are held during Eid.
